$description: MediaCard's asset and collection parts (platform/components/Card), library wave 12, lane A: the tokens of the new parts only (the card's own are in components.tokens.json). The format Badge's place over the media, the status Badge's space under the meta, and a collection's two sheets above the cover card. The Badges are Badge's own.

media-card-type-inset-block-start.$description: MediaCard asset: the format Badge's distance from the media's top (space-inset-xs, 4px).

media-card-type-inset-inline-end.$description: MediaCard asset: the format Badge's distance from the media's end edge (space-inset-xs, 4px).

media-card-status-padding-block-start.$description: MediaCard asset: the space above the status Badge, under the meta (space-stack-xs, 4px).

media-card-stack-sheet-height.$description: MediaCard collection: how much of each sheet shows above the card in front of it (4px).

media-card-stack-sheet-background.$description: MediaCard collection: a sheet's fill, the card's own surface.

media-card-stack-sheet-border-color.$description: MediaCard collection: a sheet's border, the card's own border color.

media-card-stack-sheet-border-width.$description: MediaCard collection: a sheet's border width, the card's own.

media-card-stack-sheet-radius.$description: MediaCard collection: a sheet's top corners (radius-card-4px: a 4px sheet cannot show the card's 12px corner).

media-card-stack-back-inset.$description: MediaCard collection: how much narrower the back sheet is at each side (16px).

media-card-stack-middle-inset.$description: MediaCard collection: how much narrower the middle sheet is at each side (8px).
